notes.title: 💃Dance Segment Practice Mode and the Brand - new UI design have been launched
notes.content:
🎵Hello dear players! We are happy to announce that the latest update is now live, bringing new features to enhance your gaming experience.

🌟New Features: 
1. Brand-new UI Design: Sleeker, smoother, and easier to navigate!
2. Dance Segment Practice Mode: Now available in the Studio—master those tricky moves with ease!
3. Rhythm Tasks: A brand-new task system combining daily and weekly challenges. Keep dancing and earn rewards!
4. Coach-Facing Mode: In the Studio, the coach now faces you.
5. Coach Selection Option: Choose your favorite coach to guide you through your sessions.
6. Quick Access: Access Practice Mode and MR Mode right from the Home screen.
7. New Costume Sets: Time to style up with some fresh looks!

🔧Optimizations and Bug Fixes: 
1. Fixed the issue preventing Index devices from playing the game.
2. Resolved camera shaking in LIV mode.
3. Fixed Aaliyah's outfit transparency issue in MR mode.

🔥 Dive in and explore these new features and fixes now! 🔥

💡 We deeply value your gaming experience and will continue to actively gather your feedback and suggestions to keep improving the game. Your involvement is incredibly important to us! We also welcome you to join our Discord community to connect with us and other players: https://discord.gg/danceeden.

notes.title: 🎉 Dance Eden is now live on Steam Early Access! 🎉
notes.content:
🎉 Dance Eden is now live on Steam Early Access! 🎉
🕺 Multiplayer Fun: Dive into our real-time multiplayer XR dance experience! Dance together with friends and players worldwide.
🎶 Music & Dance: Groove to 40 energetic songs with 80 original choreographies, featuring styles like choreography, hip-hop, jazz, and fitness dance.
🏠 Immersive Environments: Explore 3 unique environments:
- Personal Room: Invite friends over to chat and dance.
- Practice Studio: Perfect your moves in a beginner-friendly space.
- Plaza Stage: Unlock this advanced venue to showcase your performance.
👗 Customization: Express yourself with a high level of Avatar customization. Choose from a variety of stylish outfits, accessories, and makeup to define your unique look.
Come and join the dance party! 💃🕺
👉 Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/danceeden
